description: Ministry of Land & Parliamentary Reforms  - Extended  the Service of Land Acquiring Officer Mr. Viraj Thilkarathe, Gampaha District till 08.02.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is primarily about land acquisition matters. It specifically extends the service of an officer to function as an Acquiring Officer for Land Acquisition duties under the Land Acquisition Act. The content focuses on land-related administrative procedures (appointment for land acquisition duties) rather than government structural changes or personnel matters that would fall under Types 1-3. This fits clearly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which includes land acquisitions and property-related administrative matters.
